title: PAL Commerce Catalog Intelligence
description: Audit and remediate ecommerce product feeds, validate GTINs, compare feed snapshots, or validate x402 declarations.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Choose the commerce-data operation to run.

feedUrl.title: Public product feed URL
feedUrl.description: Optional for catalog operations. Public HTTP(S) Google Merchant XML, CSV, or TSV feed. Up to 10 MB / 1,000 products.

feedContent.title: Pasted product feed
feedContent.description: Optional for catalog operations. Paste XML, CSV, or TSV feed content instead of using a URL.

records.title: Product records
records.description: Optional for catalog operations. Supply JSON records directly instead of a feed. Up to 1,000 products; processed in 100-product batches.

gtins.title: GTINs
gtins.description: Used by gtin-check. Supply 1-1,000 GTIN/UPC/EAN values; processed in batches.

before.title: Feed snapshot before
before.description: Used by feed-diff. Up to 100 rows.

after.title: Feed snapshot after
after.description: Used by feed-diff. Up to 100 rows.

declaration.title: x402 declaration
declaration.description: Used by x402-validate. Provide an x402 v2 PaymentRequired declaration.
